shots.content: Inside a living room, a rectangular coffee table stands between a bookcase and the doorway. A two-seat sofa runs along one long side, facing two armchairs along the opposite side. A man in a red shirt sits in the bookcase-side armchair and recounts dance partners from the evening ball, a man in a green shirt sits in the doorway-side armchair, a woman in an orange shirt sits in the bookcase-side sofa seat, and a woman in a white shirt sits in the doorway-side sofa seat.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and both armchairs and the bookcase in frame.

shots.content: A man in a red shirt and a man in a green shirt exchange seats.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two armchairs.

shots.content: A man in a green shirt asks to stop reviewing the evening dances.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the coffee-table side, centered on the person at the bookcase-side armchair.

shots.content: A man in a red shirt insists on finishing the account of the ball.
shots.viewpoint: Reverse wide shot of the coffee table.
